hunks.sol: I drew a deep breath, letting the cold air seep into my lungs. As I gazed up at the star-filled sky, thinking of Sichuan in the Murim somewhere out there, a small hand tapped me on the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “Coming with me? I’m thinking of having a light drink.”
hunks.sol: “Want to come along? I’m thinking of having a drink.”

hunks.baseline: It was Faye Chen. Two of the people included in that “us” stood behind her.
hunks.sol: It was Faye Chen. Two other members of that “us” stood behind her.

hunks.baseline: One of them spoke in a voice overflowing with dignity.
hunks.sol: One of them spoke in a voice brimming with dignity.

hunks.baseline: Prince Felix answered with a displeased expression.
hunks.sol: Prince Felix answered with a displeased look.

hunks.baseline: “I might be deployed to the front tomorrow, so I’d feel more at ease if I at least prepared my spells with Memorize.”
hunks.sol: “I might be deployed to the front tomorrow. I’d feel more at ease if I at least prepared my spells with Memorize.”

hunks.baseline: As expected of an Archmage. Heroes of the Great Cataclysm didn’t become heroes for no reason.
hunks.sol: As expected of an Archmage. Heroes of the Great Cataclysm didn’t become heroes for nothing.

hunks.baseline: Deeply impressed by Magic Johnson’s attitude, I opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: Deeply impressed by Magic Johnson’s attitude, I spoke up.

hunks.baseline: Unbelievable. Leaving aside the fact that she was throwing around such unreasonable demands, that ajumma was something else for wanting to drink in a situation like this.
hunks.sol: Unbelievable. Never mind her completely unreasonable demands—that ajumma was really something else, suggesting drinks at a time like this.

hunks.baseline: “You just cursed me in your head, didn’t you? You called me a clueless ajumma who only thinks about drinking in a situation like this.”
hunks.sol: “You just cursed me in your head, didn’t you? You called me a thoughtless ajumma for wanting to drink at a time like this.”

hunks.baseline: Faye Chen poked me on the tip of the nose with one long finger. She looked like a beautiful woman in her early twenties, but in reality, she was older than my mother, which gave me a strange feeling.
hunks.sol: Faye Chen poked the tip of my nose with one long finger. She looked like a beautiful woman in her early twenties, but she was actually older than my mother. It felt strange.

hunks.baseline: “How about you find someone else? Mr. Lee, perhaps……”
hunks.sol: “Why don’t you find someone else? Mr. Lee, perhaps……”

hunks.baseline: Faye Chen tilted her head slightly. Lee Jungryong had disappeared a long time ago with the Ares Guild members he had brought with him.
hunks.sol: Faye Chen tilted her head slightly. Lee Jungryong had long since disappeared with the Ares Guild members he had brought with him.

hunks.baseline: Faye Chen cast a sidelong glance at another candidate disappearing in the distance before continuing.
hunks.sol: Faye Chen cast a sidelong glance at another candidate disappearing into the distance before continuing.

hunks.baseline: I gazed blankly at Wu Heixing’s back as he headed into the secluded forest and answered.
hunks.sol: I gazed at Wu Heixing’s back as he headed into the deserted forest and answered.

hunks.baseline: War exhausted people. At the same time, it brought unexpected farewells in the form of death.
hunks.sol: War wore people down. It also brought unexpected farewells in the form of death.

hunks.baseline: This was her own eve-of-battle ritual, after losing countless comrades during the Great Cataclysm.
hunks.sol: This was her own eve-of-battle ritual after losing countless comrades during the Great Cataclysm.

hunks.baseline: Once this crisis was over, one of us might have crossed the river from which no one ever returned.
hunks.sol: By the time this crisis was over, one of us might have crossed the river from which no one ever returned.

hunks.baseline: “Well, since things have turned out this way, I have no choice but to change my target. Right, handsome young man?”
hunks.sol: “Well, since things have turned out this way, I’ll have to find a new target. Right, handsome young man?”

hunks.baseline: Faye Chen stared at me with an incredulous expression.
hunks.sol: Faye Chen stared at me incredulously.

hunks.baseline: “Do you have no conscience? I mean the young man over there, not you.”
hunks.sol: “Do you have no shame? I meant that young man over there, not you.”

hunks.baseline: The handsome young man Faye Chen pointed out—Team Leader Choi—nodded readily, contrary to my expectations.
hunks.sol: The handsome young man Faye Chen had singled out—Team Leader Choi—nodded readily, contrary to my expectations.

hunks.baseline: “If you would invite me, it would be my honor.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re inviting me, it would be my honor.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. When will I ever have another chance to share a drink with Faye Chen? Besides, there are a lot of things I’m curious about.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. When will I ever have another chance to share a drink with Faye Chen? Besides, there are many things I’m curious about.”

hunks.baseline: “I thought you were only handsome, but you speak sweetly, too. So, what are you so curious about?”
hunks.sol: “I thought you were only handsome, but you’re sweet with words, too. So, what are you so curious about?”

hunks.baseline: “He’s no pushover either.”
hunks.sol: “You’re quite a handful yourself.”

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson burst into hearty laughter as he watched Faye Chen sigh deeply.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson burst into hearty laughter as he watched Faye Chen heave a deep sigh.

hunks.baseline: As expected of Time magazine’s choice for the world’s most influential LGBT person.
hunks.sol: As expected of *Time* magazine’s choice for the world’s most influential LGBT person.

hunks.baseline: I sent Sound Transmission to Team Leader Choi, who was dragged away with his body stiff as a board.
hunks.sol: I sent Team Leader Choi a Sound Transmission as he was dragged away, stiff as a board.

hunks.baseline: “Call me if anything happens.”
hunks.sol: —Call me if anything happens.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi looked back at me with sad eyes, like a cow being led to the slaughterhouse, then disappeared with the two S-rank Hunters.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi looked back at me with mournful eyes, like a cow being led to the slaughterhouse, then disappeared with the two S-rank Hunters.

hunks.baseline: How long had I walked along the dark path, avoiding people’s eyes? I stopped in the pitch-black darkness and opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: After walking along the dark path for some time, keeping out of sight, I stopped in the pitch-black darkness and spoke.

hunks.baseline: After a brief silence, someone’s voice drifted out.
hunks.sol: After a brief silence, someone’s voice drifted from the darkness.

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing appeared amid the sound of movement and looked me up and down.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing emerged with the sound and looked me up and down.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t pretend to praise me now. It’s obvious you’re trying to pull some cheap trick.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t pretend to praise me now. It’s obvious you’re trying to pull something.”

hunks.baseline: “It wasn’t like that. I sincerely……”
hunks.sol: “I-it wasn’t like that. I sincerely……”

hunks.baseline: “You sincerely think I’m a bangzi. You were annoyed because some Korean who isn’t even an official S-rank Hunter yet was getting more attention than you. You picked a fight first with your usual one-dimensional behavior, but the reaction wasn’t good, and that bangzi turned out to be less of a pushover than you expected, right?”
hunks.sol: “You sincerely think I’m a bangzi. You were pissed because some random Korean who isn’t even officially an S-rank Hunter was getting all the attention instead of you. hunks.baseline: I continued firing off words like a machine gun without giving him a chance to answer.
hunks.sol: I kept firing off words like a machine gun without giving him a chance to answer.

hunks.baseline: “So now you’re throwing out a few compliments you don’t mean and making friendly gestures, trying to pull some kind of trick…… Wait. Is any part of what I just said wrong?”
hunks.sol: “So now you’re tossing out a few compliments you don’t mean and making friendly gestures while you try to pull something…… Wait, was any part of what I just said wrong?”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, I’ve seen plenty of people like you. After getting hit in the back of the head so many times, even the brain that wouldn’t work started spinning.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah, I’ve met plenty of guys like you. I’ve been smacked in the back of the head so many times that even my useless brain finally started turning.”

hunks.baseline: I gave him a contemptuous look, and the red-faced Wu Heixing began to stammer.
hunks.sol: When I gave him a contemptuous look, the red-faced Wu Heixing began to stammer.

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t trying to pull some other trick.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t trying to pull anything else.”

hunks.baseline: “Then what? If you’re thinking of becoming friends with me, fold that idea up neatly and put it away. If you stand next to shit, the smell gets on me too.”
hunks.sol: “Then what? If you’re thinking of becoming friends with me, fold that idea up neatly and put it away. Stand next to shit and the smell rubs off on you.”

hunks.baseline: At my quiet question, the hand moving toward his sword hilt stopped abruptly.
hunks.sol: At my quiet question, the hand creeping toward his sword hilt stopped dead.

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing looked at me with conflicted eyes before suddenly speaking.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing looked at me with conflicted eyes before blurting out a question.

hunks.baseline: “You already knew everything…… So why did you come along so willingly?”
hunks.sol: “You already knew…… So why did you come along so willingly?”

hunks.baseline: I looked straight into Wu Heixing’s eyes and opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I looked straight into Wu Heixing’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: His stiffened face was answer enough. I had wondered if it was possible, but apparently it was. I scratched the back of my head and muttered.
hunks.sol: His rigid expression was answer enough. I’d thought it might be possible, but this was still surprising. Scratching the back of my head, I muttered,

hunks.baseline: “I guess it is. Well, this is the mainland, so I suppose various martial arts could have survived here. An internal-energy cultivation technique, for example.”
hunks.sol: “I guess it was. Well, this is the mainland, so I suppose various martial arts might have survived here. An internal-energy cultivation technique, for example.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, look at you.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, please.”

hunks.baseline: A snort escaped me at the sight of him hurriedly making excuses.
hunks.sol: A snort escaped me at the sight of him scrambling to make excuses.

hunks.baseline: *Take a look at me for a moment.*
hunks.sol: *Come see me for a moment.*

hunks.baseline: I had responded to an invitation I could have ignored because Wu Heixing himself had been the one to send it.
hunks.sol: I had accepted an invitation I could easily have ignored because Wu Heixing himself had sent it.

hunks.baseline: “H-how did you know that?”
hunks.sol: “H-how did you know?”

hunks.baseline: “Why? Was it a secret no one else knew?”
hunks.sol: “Why? Was it some secret no one else knew?”

hunks.baseline: “I thought it was possible, but it’s still fascinating. Didn’t you wipe out all the martial artists during that whole Cultural Revolution business? Somehow, martial arts survived even through that.”
hunks.sol: “I thought it might be possible, but it’s still fascinating. Didn’t you people wipe out all the martial artists during that whole Cultural Revolution business? I’m impressed that martial arts survived even through that.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, right. You said your family was powerful. Did the highest-ranking Communist Party officials quietly smuggle it out by abusing their positions?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, right. You said your family was powerful. Did some top Communist Party official use his position to quietly squirrel it away?”

hunks.baseline: His expression sank instantly. I must have been right.
hunks.sol: His expression instantly went cold. I must have been right.

hunks.baseline: As a foreigner, I didn’t know how serious a problem this was, but I understood the value of internal-energy cultivation techniques—in other words, what was called mana cultivation in the modern era.
hunks.sol: As a foreigner, I didn’t know how serious a problem this was, but I understood the value of an internal-energy cultivation technique—in other words, what was called a mana cultivation technique in the modern era.

hunks.baseline: *If this had been the Murim, there would have been a river of blood.*
hunks.sol: *If this were the Murim, there would’ve been a bloodbath.*

hunks.baseline: He had been caught hiding away a golden calf like that. Naturally, Wu Heixing wasn’t reacting well.
hunks.sol: He had been caught secretly hoarding a golden calf like that. Naturally, Wu Heixing wasn’t reacting well.

hunks.baseline: “I had no particular intention of doing so, but your tone is pretty damn offensive.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t planning to, but I really don’t like your tone.”

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing glared at me with vicious eyes.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing glared at me with venomous eyes.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know who your father is, but he sounds like he might have been a former Red Guard.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know who your father is, but he sounds like he might have been a Red Guard.”

hunks.baseline: With a furious shout, his body shot forward.
hunks.sol: With a furious shout, he shot forward.

hunks.baseline: The Aura Blade surging from the straight sword already drawn from its sheath—no, the Sword Force—flew toward my throat.
hunks.sol: An Aura Blade—no, Sword Force—surged from the straight sword already drawn from its sheath and hurtled toward my throat.

hunks.baseline: The cool wind scattered my hair. I bent backward until my waist nearly touched the ground and avoided the Sword Force, then sprang up and drove my knee into his chin.
hunks.sol: The cool wind scattered my hair. I bent backward until my waist nearly touched the ground, letting the Sword Force pass overhead, then sprang upright and drove my knee into his chin.

hunks.baseline: Teeth and blood flew into the air. As Wu Heixing staggered, I seized both his arms and whispered into his ear.
hunks.sol: Teeth and blood flew through the air. As Wu Heixing staggered, I seized both his arms and whispered in his ear.

hunks.baseline: The powerful Scorching Yang Qi in both hands shattered his armor and burned his flesh.
hunks.sol: The powerful Scorching Yang Qi coursing through my hands shattered his armor and burned his flesh.

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing’s scream was blocked by the qi barrier I had spread out and failed to travel any farther.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing’s scream struck the qi barrier I had spread around us and went no farther.

hunks.baseline: *Compared to the Murim, the quality of the martial arts is far lower.*
hunks.sol: *Compared to the Murim, the quality of his martial arts is much lower.*

hunks.baseline: I felt a slight sense of disappointment as I reached out.
hunks.sol: Slightly disappointed, I reached out.

hunks.baseline: His leg, swung like a whip toward my waist, could go no farther.
hunks.sol: His leg, whipping toward my waist, stopped dead.

hunks.sol: By the time I stopped using him as a human pickaxe, Wu Heixing lay spread-eagled in a huge crater, looking as though his soul had left his body.

hunks.sol: “Still, you’ve got a sturdy body. You’re barely hurt.”

hunks.sol: I stared in surprise at the sprawled-out Wu Heixing. Even for an S-rank Hunter, carrying something like this around was absurd.

hunks.sol: High-grade potions were rare enough, but top-grade potions appeared maybe once or twice a year.

hunks.baseline: Leaving aside their almost unreal price, they were so scarce that even people with money couldn’t obtain them.
hunks.sol: Their almost unreal price aside, they were so scarce that even people with money couldn’t get their hands on one.

hunks.sol: *I’ve only ever seen these online, and now there’s one right in front of me.*

hunks.sol: After a moment’s hesitation, I slipped the top-grade potion into my Inventory. Then I searched his pouch again, found a high-grade potion, and poured it over him.
